preview.text: Pick the beans.

reasons: Waterlogged! Soggy, packed soil has no air for roots. Better structure (compost) helps it drain.
Chilly: warm-season beans grows slowly at about 19°C.
Nutrients are low. Try compost or a legume like beans or clover.
